title: Juniper Table: prices, waiting and clear expectations

source.name: RestaurantOS fictional conversation fixture
source.method: Invented messages and explicit reply/repost links for exercising the content-plus-connectivity pipeline. No real guests or accounts.
limitations: Synthetic sample; no observed customer findings or real dissemination claims.
Small fictional conversation with linked pricing, wait-time and takeaway threads.

messages.text: Menu prices should include every service charge so the final bill is clear.
Clear menu prices help us budget. Hidden service fees make dinner feel expensive.
I agree about clear prices. Please show fees before we order.
We will test showing the full price on the menu instead of adding a service fee.
The Saturday queue was long. A reservation estimate would make waiting easier.
Our group waited for a table too. Reservations need a realistic wait estimate.
A clear wait estimate and a text when the table is ready would help.
We will try giving accurate queue updates before guests arrive.
Clear expectations matter for both menu fees and the queue. Please communicate prices and waits early.
Sharing this idea: put the full price on the menu and explain all service charges.
The same clarity would help reservations: explain the wait before guests travel.
Our fries were soft by the time we got home. Could takeaway boxes have vents?
Vented boxes would help with fries. Keep the salad and dressing in a separate bag.
Our packaging test put the sauce on the side and used a vented box for the hot food.
That would also make pickup easier to check. Add a label for sauces and dietary notes.
Labels would help. My takeaway order was ready, but I could not tell which bag was ours.
A marked pickup shelf and a clear order number would let the host focus on the queue.
The crowded pickup shelf and the reservation queue do run into each other on Saturday.
A separate pickup sign could make it easier for guests to find the reservations line.
The menu trial will show the full meal price and identify any optional add-ons separately.
Please use the same price labels on the takeaway menu so people can compare before ordering.
The menu labels are useful if people can see them before getting to the pickup counter.
Sharing the vented box test with the takeaway team so we can compare results next weekend.
A text with the wait estimate and the pickup directions could save a trip to the host stand.
